source.interpretation: MissionReliability.PFF applies a mission-specific factor to ordinary system FRT during mission preparation; its default is zero. The item-free traditional system can be targeted by IID <SYSTEM>. MissionPreparation.DURN supplies actual exposure; PFF zero versus positive is isolated while MFF inherits the accepted RISK-MISSION default. Calendar failure behavior is outside scope.

predeclared_native_acceptance: Parent-to-child tables change only by description, one RISK-MISSION MissionPreparation row with DURN one hour, and one RISK-MISSION MissionReliability <SYSTEM> row. The two arms differ only in PFF zero versus ten and description; all other system, mission, maintenance, resource and stock configuration is identical.

Each arm must run under guarded session-0 SSH, acquire Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue, preserve GUI PID 13340, import/export all authored row-containing tables exactly, have zero converter errors, and produce nonempty SXO, event log and JSON report.

Enumerate and interpret every native converter warning and note after each run. Any diagnostic indicating that preparation, PFF or the MissionReliability row was ignored or invalid blocks behavioral acceptance even when Errors is zero.

The zero-PFF arm must show an actual one-hour RISK-MISSION preparation interval with no random failure inside it. The positive-PFF arm must log a random failure strictly between its preparation start and end, or before a native preparation abort, on the prepared aircraft. Exact failure time and downstream mission assignment/repair are observations, not presupposed.
Reconcile the preparation fault to mission assignment or abort, direct repair, resource occupancy, report ledgers and terminal state as emitted. Do not infer a statistical rate from one seed.
Seal the raw source, invocation, closure and native outputs; a separate read-only reviewer must replay the matched source delta and native events without importing author validation.
limits: One seed, two aircraft, an item-free traditional system and one one-hour RISK-MISSION preparation at a high synthetic PFF only.
The experiment does not establish other PFF values, per-item or failure-mode targeting, calendar-rate behavior, general hazard law, GUI visual behavior or cross-engine parity.
Full D08 and Issue #18 remain open.
